en.headline: Thunderstorm warning issued for isolated storms this morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 6.45 am valid until 7.45 am as isolated thunderstorms are expected over the territory.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 6.45 am on Saturday, saying the warning would remain in force until 7.45 am.
Isolated thunderstorms are expected to occur over Hong Kong, according to the Observatory.
The public is advised to take precautions, stay away from highly conductive objects, trees or masts, and avoid outdoor activities while the warning is in force.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 料有孤立雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台於今早6時45分發出雷暴警告，有效至7時45分，預料本港有孤立雷暴。
body: 香港天文台於今日（8月1日）早上6時45分發出雷暴警告，表示警告將維持至早上7時45分。
天文台表示，預料本港有孤立雷暴。
市民應採取適當預防措施，遠離導電物體、樹木或桅杆，並在警告生效期間盡量避免戶外活動。
